test_ball_query_naive_vs_cuda: test the ball_query naive implementation against the CUDA version for correctness on square point clouds
test_ball_query_ragged_tensor: test the ball_query operation with ragged tensors using variable lengths on CPU and CUDA devices
test_ball_query_output_simple: test ball_query output on icosphere sampled points verifying neighbor counts at large and small radii
